source_event.reason: A material test commit was added after the published handoff, leaving the certificate and exact-SHA quantitative evidence bound to an ancestor; the certificate also used an obsolete contract version.

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A valid result-only handoff becomes stale when any later repository commit changes a material path, including test or documentation paths; quantitative evidence cannot be inherited across that new material SHA.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Classify test-only or documentation-only commits after handoff as harmless metadata and reuse the ancestor certificate/benchmark without post-write refreeze.

reusable_control.rule: After any repository write, compare current head against the published handoff; any non-allowlisted path forces post-write refreeze and exact-SHA quantitative evidence rerun.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Treat tests, documentation, formatting and product code as material unless explicitly allowlisted as result-only evidence; invalidate freeze descendants after such a write.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: At terminal handoff, require direct parent == material head, all child paths allowlisted, current remote head == published child, and quantitative subject_sha == material head.

transfer_cases.scenario: A test file changes after a valid handoff.
Benchmark still names the ancestor after material drift.

skill_changes.change: Universal post-write latch explicitly treats test/documentation commits as material and requires post-write refreeze.
Quantitative evidence must be re-executed on the exact new material head after any material write.
